messages:
Nadia: Whoa 1st & Folsom just got pelted by hail. Tiny meteor shower. Cars sloshing. Anyone coming from the Marina beware.
Omar: Just saw two scooters do the classic banana peel slide. All good but dramatic.
Kai: If you're biking, reroute via Market rather than 21st 1st is a skating rink now.
commute-bot: BART update: Minor delays on the T-line due to signal verification. Expect 10-20m impact during peak.
Zoe: Office note: front desk has a bin of towel packs and a few plastic bags for wet shoes. Help yourselves.
Nadia: Im at 22nd and can offer a dry seat in my Prius for two. Leaving in 12. Ping if you need a pickup.
Omar: ETA? Im near Van Ness, might hop in if you pass by.
Kai: Also, if anyone's lost a blue umbrella with a duck sticker, I picked it up by the mural and dropped it at reception.
Zoe: Thanks for the heads-up Nadia. Front desk will post a sticky: "Carpool pickup - Nadia 8:20"
commute-bot: MUNI alert: Routes 22 and 8 detoured between Folsom and 3rd. Shuttle options posted inside the transit tab.
Omar: Saved by Nadia 12 minutes till standup but caffeinated and dry.
Kai: PSA: keep electronics in ziplocks if rain/hail looks sketchy today. Learned the hard way.
Zoe: Office memo: free commuter lockers in the bike room today for soggy gear.
Nadia: Carpool full, but happy to shuttle people to the BART station. Stay safe everyone. :umbrella:
Omar: Big thanks. Hero of commute hour. :trophy:
